threshold.measure: The inline row's natural single-line width (heading, count, and every entry's name, value and Turn off at max-content, plus the gaps between them) compared with the row's available width (the #enabledMods content box: clientWidth minus its horizontal padding) at the current window size.
threshold.onLoad: inline when natural <= available, else tray

tray.scrollCue: After scrollsAfter entries the list ends in a bottom fade into the tray surface and shows a thin always-visible scrollbar thumb, so more entries read as below.

motion.keyboard: none: opened or closed from the keyboard it appears and goes at once

enabledMods.announceAfterTurnOff: polite live region, separate from #toast and #saveIndicator

undoToast.placement: fixed bottom zone above the status bar, stacked above #toast; never over the scrolling content

idleSwitch.rule: An ON slider switch is idle (color/switch/idle) while its mod is not in the Enabled mods list, which is while its value sits at its default; it uses color/accent once the mod is listed, marked by data-live on label.slider-switch. Visual only: what the switch sends is unchanged. Monster Density's #den_on is not a .slider-switch and keeps its own look. OFF keeps the knob left on the quiet color/border/subtle body.

trackSeparation.note: Round 2 (owner, 2026-09-25): idle is a lighter, cooler neutral than the slider track, so an idle switch no longer blends with the track beside it. Luminance ratio idle:track shown per palette; idle also keeps 3:1 or more on color/bg/raised and the knob (color/text/primary) keeps 3:1 or more on idle.

switchLabels.rule: A standalone switch (a toggle row, Density's #den_on) carries its text immediately left of the switch: toggle rows their on/off state, Density its fixed Enabled label. A slider switch carries none, because its value box carries the state. No string changes.

typeScale.rule: The 12/13/14 steps are separated by weight and colour, not by dropping a size: 12 is notes and meta (regular, color/text/faint or muted), 13 is row labels (medium, color/text/primary) and descriptions (regular, color/text/muted), 14 is body text and values. Sizes are unchanged, so no measured width moved.

setupEmphasis.rule: While the mod chain is incomplete, Install Mod Plugin is the primary button and Launch Modded Game secondary; they swap once the chain is complete.
setupEmphasis.chainIncompleteSignal: the Setup chain warning is shown

quietHelpers.rule: A slider row's .note is hidden while its switch is idle, unless the row is hovered or has focus; the pool footer drops its positive/negative counts, which repeat the column heads.

finishing a dig also digs the two nearest veins within 192 units that you could mine yourself, each at 4×, through the game's own dig. A vein dug this way never starts another.

For an item forged with Mechanic: Headhunter. While on, killing a rare or champion monster grants its affixes to you as 20-second buffs (Extra Fast → movement speed, Berserker/Raging/Enraged → attack speed, Vampiric → life replenish, elemental Enchanted → cast rate, others → movement speed for now). The equipped-belt check is still in progress, so the effect is active whenever this switch is on and the forged item exists.
Tyrant's Crown: more rares, richer rares

For an item forged with Mechanic: Tyrant's Crown. While on, normal monsters near you rise to rare more often (15% each) and every rare or champion carries one extra affix. Pairs with Headhunter: more rares, more affixes to steal.

For an amulet forged with Mechanic: Beacon. While on, every monster on the map hunts you the moment it spawns and never turns back, through the game's own aggro system. Plugin commands: beaconmode rare limits it to rares and champions, beaconrange <px> caps the distance.

Choose the features you want for your offline adventure.
Toggle drop pool adjustments and quality-of-life tweaks for your offline session. Settings apply immediately while the game is running.
Remove owned relics from drop pool
When a relic is dropped, prevents relics already at maximum level (10 out of 10) in your equipped slots, backpack, or inventory from dropping.
Experience and Magic Find orb pickup radius
Makes the player collect matching orbs from 10 times the normal distance.
Reveals the full minimap in every zone (removes fog of war). Waypoints, dungeon entrances, chests, shrines and mining nodes come with it - they are hidden by the fog, not by anything else.
Show every monster pack on the map

Most mob packs do not exist until you walk near them, so the revealed map used to show only the packs you had already met. This marks every pack's spot and kind (normal, champion, ancient, legion, mini boss) on the minimap the moment you arrive, including density copies, without creating a single monster: the pack is still born by the game when you walk near it, and its real dots replace the marker. Costs nothing per frame beyond the markers themselves.
Really spawn every pack on arrival (heavy)

The old way: each new zone creates all of its packs, including density copies, as you arrive. Every living monster costs the game frame time on top of the markers, so at high density this lags for the whole zone. Off by default; only for comparing against the markers.

While your pet is out, it walks to quest items on screen and picks them up for you - one at a time, crediting the quest objective exactly as collecting it by hand does. Only applies to pick-up quest items; things you activate, break or talk to are left alone.
Auto-prospect items put in the Prospect Cube

Every item you drag or click into the Prospect Cube's grid is prospected straight away, as if you had pressed Prospect, so the grid never fills with items waiting their turn. Anything still in the prospect grid when the game saves is lost.
Move the previous materials to your materials tab

When the next item is prospected, the materials from the prospect before it go from the grid to your materials tab first, the way clicking them does. The newest batch stays in the grid where you can see it. A material the game will not take stays in the grid.

Crafting Cube recipes also count the materials and socketables in your stash's Materials and Socketable tabs. When you craft, only what your bag is short of leaves the stash, and the stash is saved right after. Off by default.

For a fixed set of toggle skills, each measured in-game: draws a soft red outline around that skill's skill-bar slot while its toggle is running, so you can see at a glance that it is still active. The outline disappears when the toggle ends. A plain cast, made without the skill's toggle sub-talent, lights nothing.
Stop double cast re-casting a toggle skill

For that same fixed set of toggle skills: a double cast proc can cast one of them a second time on its own, which flips its toggle straight back to where it was before your press. With this on, that extra cast is skipped, so the toggle stays the way you set it. It only steps in when you actually have the skill's toggle sub-talent, or the skill is a toggle on its own; your own presses are never affected.

The pause menu's Restart normally waits until you have been out of combat for a few seconds; with this on it works straight away. Use the mouse: in combat Restart still looks greyed until the cursor is on it, then lights up and works when clicked.

Shows how much time a timed skill has left, over that skill's slot on the skill bar, in the look you pick below. Works for most timed skills; toggles and companions (turrets, totems) don't get one. Off by default.

Reflow freeze: the other entries keep their places until the pointer leaves the list or reflowFreeze.maxMs passes. Focus: when the used Turn off had focus it moves to the next entry's Turn off, else the previous one, else the heading (in the tray, the count control). A polite live region announces it and the undo toast offers Undo. Reduced motion: opacity only.

Switch off: the knob sits left on the quiet color/border/subtle body, the slider dims to 35%, .val reads off, and the remembered value is shown beside it. The ON switch here is listed (value +25%), so it keeps the accent.

Picker open from the Theme control in the Setup tab's Appearance card (moved there by the owner's polish pass, 2026-09-25; the panel draws it as the ThemePicker since the finish review, F2: a trigger and a listbox that opens below it), plus one section in each palette. Each option's swatch shows border/strong, text/muted and the accent, so the neutral temperature tells Ledger (warm) from Graphite (cool grey) and Sigil (blue grey).
World 1280, 3 entries, natural 912 <= available 1216: inline. Unlisted ON slider switches are idle; Density's live slider is drawn in the ON style.
World 900, 2 entries, natural 709 <= 836: inline on load; inside the hysteresis band when coming from the tray.

World 1280, 13 entries: the tray popover open under the rail count, floating over the header while open (closes on Escape, an outside click or a tab change). The listed rows Rare +25%, Ancient +10% and Speed bonus x1.5 keep the accent switch.
World 900, the same 3 entries as enabled-inline-1280: natural 912 > 836, so the tray; drawn open as the popover.

The measure, the two thresholds (natural > available -> tray; natural <= available - 160 -> row), the band and the on-load rule. Hold: the switch waits while a pointer button or a key is down and while the popover is open, then for hold.idleMs.

An ON slider switch is idle (color/switch/idle) while its mod is not listed, and takes the accent once listed (data-live). Idle, on and off rows drawn in all three palettes, with the listed entry. Density's #den_on keeps its look. A row at its default carries no note (owner, 2026-09-26), so hovering or focusing an idle row at its default shows nothing. A note an idle row does carry (a value moved and not yet saved) is a tooltip above the row: color/bg/hover with a 1px color/border/subtle edge and radius/md, text color/text/muted, left-aligned with the row and no wider than it, its bottom just above the row's top; the row and the next row stay put (owner, 2026-09-25: never drawn over the row below, and nothing moves).

Closed, open and closing. Opens from #enabledModsCount; keyboard open puts focus on the first Turn off; Escape returns focus to the count; an outside click or a tab change closes it. Pointer open scales 0.97 to 1 from the count over motion/duration/base on motion/easing/emphasized, close over motion/duration/fast; from the keyboard it appears at once.

After Turn off on Reveal full map: the undo toast (Reveal full map turned off, Undo) above the handler's own #toast (map reveal OFF - ok) in the fixed bottom zone; after Undo the undo toast leaves and #toast reads map reveal ON - ok. The polite live-region lines are shown as captions. Enter over motion/duration/base, exit over motion/duration/fast.
Setup at the minimum window, 900x600: the subtitle shares the title's line and the list sits in the rail as the count, so the first setting starts higher.

The plugin warning (owner's polish pass, 2026-09-25): the color/warn icon beside Apply all now, its tooltip open below it on color/bg/hover (radius/md, a 1px color/border/subtle edge, the same surface as an idle slider note's tooltip) with the message in color/text/primary and an Open Setup line in color/text/muted, font/size/xs; the same icon beside Settings loaded in the status bar opens its tooltip upward. On Setup the Open Setup line is not shown. The icon opens Setup; the tooltip holds nothing to click. nodeId and screenshot are filled in when the Figma file is brought in line with this amendment.

components.name: PluginWarning
components.notes: A full-width band in color/warn/tint with the warning icon (color/warn, original vector, decorative: the restyle renders it as span.plugin-warning-icon aria-hidden) before the text; no side rule and no stroke (owner, following impeccable, round 3). On Setup the Open Setup button is hidden (finding 18) and the band carries the text only.

motion.notes: Tokens: motion/duration/fast 120ms, base 200ms; motion/easing/standard cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1), emphasized cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), hover cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.1, 0.25, 1). Animate only transform and opacity. Hover colour changes: motion/duration/fast on motion/easing/hover, gated by (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine). Buttons scale(0.97) on :active over motion/duration/fast on motion/easing/standard. Focus and keyboard actions are never animated. The tray popover scales from its trigger (0.97 to 1, with opacity) over motion/duration/base on motion/easing/emphasized and closes over motion/duration/fast on motion/easing/standard; opened from the keyboard it appears at once. The theme picker's listbox scales from its trigger (0.97 to 1, with opacity) over motion/duration/base on motion/easing/emphasized and closes over motion/duration/fast on motion/easing/standard; opened from the keyboard it appears at once. Toasts enter over motion/duration/base and leave over motion/duration/fast on motion/easing/standard. A removed list entry fades and scales to 0.95 over motion/duration/fast. prefers-reduced-motion removes movement and scale (transform, translate, scale and rotate), while opacity fades and colour fades stay.
